lifecycle_description: Qualitative codebook evolution across 150-turn research sprint

codes.name: caregiver-privacy
codes.definition: Boundaries, controls, and restrictions governing family caregiver access to patient health data.
codes.inclusion_criteria: Mentions of proxy access, shared vs private clinical records, redaction of sensitive notes, or permission delegation.
codes.exclusion_criteria: General portal login password resets or basic account creation.
anchor_quotes: My daughter needs to see appointment dates, but not my psychiatric notes.
Caregiver access must have explicit boundaries.

codes.name: audit-trail-visibility
codes.definition: Requirement that automated status transitions display verifiable clinical evidence trails.
codes.inclusion_criteria: Mentions of queue verification, source trail, doctor signature, lab link, or audit logs.
codes.exclusion_criteria: General complaints about page loading latency.
anchor_quotes: I will not trust a green badge without seeing the doctor's verified note.
The queue is useful only when the source trail is visible.

codes.name: clinical-oversight
codes.definition: Physician and nurse verification protocols safeguarding AI-assisted triage decisions.
codes.inclusion_criteria: Mentions of clinician review of automated recommendations, liability, or nurse sign-off.
anchor_quotes: Physicians don't trust an AI summary that doesn't let them click straight to the patient quote.

codes.name: notification-fatigue
codes.definition: Cognitive overload and frustration resulting from repetitive or conflicting SMS and portal reminders.
codes.inclusion_criteria: Mentions of redundant texts, alerts sent during work hours, or conflicting prep instructions.
anchor_quotes: I received four text messages in one morning for the same routine blood draw.

codes.name: caregiver-proxy-scheduling
codes.definition: Positive collaborative coordination where caregivers manage logistics, transport, and calendars.
codes.inclusion_criteria: Mentions of booking visits, transportation coordination, calendar syncing, or check-in assistance.
codes.exclusion_criteria: Access to medical consultation notes or diagnostic test results.
anchor_quotes: My son helps with my prescriptions and driving me to clinic.

codes.name: caregiver-confidential-notes
codes.definition: Patient resistance and anxiety regarding proxy visibility into sensitive psychiatric, reproductive, or oncological diagnoses.
codes.inclusion_criteria: Mentions of privacy boundaries, behavioral health isolation, or desire to withhold notes from family.
anchor_quotes: My mother wants me to manage her logistics, but does not want me reading her counseling notes.

codes.name: multilingual-disparity
codes.definition: Discrepancies in clarity, cultural appropriateness, or completeness between English and non-English communications.
codes.inclusion_criteria: Mentions of machine-translated Spanish/Portuguese copy, mistranslated medical terms, or untranslated warning flags.
anchor_quotes: Spanish translations use clinical jargon nobody in our community understands.

codes.name: clinical-provenance
codes.definition: Explicit requirement that automated flags display the authoring clinician, timestamp, and EHR reference ID.
codes.inclusion_criteria: Mentions of clinician credentials, author verification, or timestamped audit ledger.
codes.exclusion_criteria: Generic system timestamps without clinical author.
anchor_quotes: Show me the date, laboratory name, and the doctor's electronic signature.

codes.name: accessibility-contrast-deficiency
codes.definition: Violations of WCAG 2.2 AA contrast standards impeding elderly and low-vision patients.
codes.inclusion_criteria: Mentions of unreadable gray text, low contrast status indicators, small touch targets, or screen reader failures.
anchor_quotes: The light gray text on white background makes it impossible for my 84-year-old eyes to read pre-op instructions.

codes.name: cognitive-load-reduction
codes.definition: Design interventions that simplify complex multi-step clinical readiness into actionable, chunked checklists.
codes.inclusion_criteria: Mentions of progressive disclosure, single-page summaries, visual progress meters, or plain-language translations.
anchor_quotes: Group the blood tests into one pre-op card instead of five separate warning banners.

codes.name: audit-immutability-governance
codes.definition: Cryptographic and database governance ensuring historical readiness evidence cannot be retroactively altered.
codes.inclusion_criteria: Mentions of append-only audit ledgers, compliance verification, tamper-evident logs, or regulatory auditability.
anchor_quotes: If a readiness status changes from ready to blocked, the audit record must preserve the previous clinician sign-off.
